![Screenshot_59](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/54272801/635517367-25bf4dea-5927-4aff-a37c-0a67cd1bd3bd.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Y9lmco0O8SApDcNM7jEofUOQ7YyKR9qUlX-bZqRcbbM) | ## Replies: 2 comments ### Uh oh! There was an error while loading. ### Uh oh! There was an error while loading. ### [![](https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/45048235?s=64&v=4)\ stefisha](https://github.com/stefisha) [2 weeks agoAug 18, 2026](https://github.com/orgs/supabase/discussions/49058#discussioncomment-18070822) | | |-| | That error usually means Claude Code has a stale OAuth client registration. Try removing and reconnecting the Supabase MCP server:
`
claude mcp remove supabase
claude mcp add --scope project --transport http supabase "https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp"
claude /mcp
`
Then select **supabase → Authenticate**.
Supabase’s hosted MCP uses dynamic client registration, so you shouldn’t need to create an OAuth app or personal access token manually.
If it still fails:
- Update Claude Code to the latest version.
- Check `.mcp.json` for an older Supabase configuration.
- Retry the authentication URL in a private browser window.
Official instructions: [[https://supabase.com/docs/guides/ai-tools/mcp](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/ai-tools/mcp)](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/ai-tools/mcp) |
